class: a Firebase write the owner did not see, or a consent that outlives a change in the account, an app or a config file
caught_by: the plan id: firebase --plan runs only read-only lookups and prints the writes with an id hashed from the steps and the signed-in account; --confirm <id> recomputes the plan and runs nothing unless it still hashes to that id
missed_by: the host's per-command prompt, which consents to one command at a time and never to the whole set of writes
